questions.stem: A 34 year old man has a 5 day history of a painful swollen right knee and left ankle. His temperature is 37.4°C, pulse rate 82 bpm and BP 128/76 mmHg.

elim: Arthritis of inflammatory bowel disease, with chronic bloody diarrhoea, not one self-limiting episode.

steps.x: **C. Reactive arthritis.** Arthritis 1 to 4 weeks after a GI or GU infection = reactive arthritis.

questions.stem: A 28 year old man develops a swollen left knee and heel pain 2 weeks after an episode of fever, abdominal cramps and bloody diarrhoea. Linked to undercooked beef and haemolytic uraemic syndrome.
A virus causing vomiting outbreaks, not a reactive arthritis trigger.

steps.x: **A. Campylobacter jejuni.** Post-enteric reactive arthritis: Campylobacter, Salmonella, Shigella.

questions.stem: A 25 year old man has a swollen left knee and gritty red eyes 3 weeks after an episode of dysuria. He has not been sexually active since then. He mentions a rash on his penis that does not hurt. He is circumcised and has no urethral discharge.

questions.stem: A 31 year old man developed a swollen right knee after Shigella dysentery 8 months ago. His infection has cleared and repeat stool cultures are negative.
